title: Heavy rain alert : 3 districts of Odisha shut schools - odisharay.com
article_text:
Bhubaneswar: The Odisha government has gone on high alert due to a deep depression over the Bay of Bengal.

Discover more Government Stream History Documentaries Subscribe To News

In view of the heavy warning issued by India Meteorological Department, collectors of three districts have ordered closure of all educational institutions.

Hire Grant Writers

In Khordha, all schools and Anganwadi centres will remain closed from September 22 to 24.

Gajapati district collector has ordered all government and private schools and Anganwadi centres to remain closed on September 22, 23 and 24 keeping the safety of students as top priority.

Similarly, Jagatsinghpur district administration has also declared school and Anganwadi holiday for the same period.

The state government has deployed men and machinery at strategic locations to deal with the impact of the deep depression likely to hit on the night of September 23.

title: Odisha assembly monsoon session begins today, key issues set to dominate house - Kalinga TV
article_text:
Odisha assembly monsoon session begins today, key issues set to dominate house
This ongoing monsoon session will conclude on October 3 after nine working days.
By Baisakhi Last updated Sep 22, 2026
 Share

Bhubaneswar: Odisha Assembly’s Monsoon session commences today with the Mines and Minerals Development and Regulation (MMDR) Act issue likely to stir things up in the House.

Yesterday, the Biju Janata Dal (BJD) had requested the Speaker, Surama Padhy to table a motion in the House regarding the MMDR issue. The Congress too is prepared to corner the ruling party on the issue.

As per reports, the Opposition is to raise issues like MMDR, textbook errors, disenfranchisement of voters by Special Intensive Revision (SIR), Mahanadi water dispute, law and order situation, poor flood management, question paper leaks and farmers’ issues.

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) which is also the ruling party held a legislature party meeting yesterday and announced its plan to take on the Opposition.

This ongoing monsoon session will conclude on October 3 after nine working days. The government has decided to introduce six bills during the session.

The House proceedings will begin at 11 AM. At the beginning of the session, condolence resolutions will be moved for the departed leaders.

title: IMD forecasts heavy to very heavy rain in Andhra Pradesh, Odisha today - News On AIR
article_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast Heavy to Very Heavy Rainfall at isolated places over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha during the day. Assam, Meghalaya, Chhattisgarh, Gangetic West Bengal and Jharkhand will experience heavy rainfall. Similar conditions are going to prevail over Karnataka, Konkan, Goa, Madhya Maharashtra and Telangana.

According to IMD, Uttarakhand is likely to experience isolated to scattered rainfall from today onwards till friday and West Madhya Pradesh till 28th september. Meanwhile in Delhi there will be mainly clear sky. The maximum and minimum temperatures in the national capital will hover around 34 degree celsius to 25 degree celsius.

title: শক্তি বাড়াচ্ছে ঘূর্ণিঝড় ‘অর্ণব’, বাংলায় ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস - Puber Kalom
article_text:
পুবের কলম ওয়েবডেস্ক, বঙ্গোপসাগরে তৈরি হওয়া নিম্নচাপ ক্রমেই শক্তি বাড়াচ্ছে। মঙ্গলবার (২২ সেপ্টেম্বর) এটি গভীর নিম্নচাপে পরিণত হতে পারে বলে জানিয়েছে আলিপুর আবহাওয়া দপ্তর। বুধবার রাত অথবা বৃহস্পতিবার ভোরে উত্তর অন্ধ্রপ্রদেশ ও দক্ষিণ ওড়িশার মাঝামাঝি উপকূলে এর স্থলভাগে ঢোকার সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। বিশাখাপত্তনম ও গোপালপুরের মধ্যবর্তী এলাকা দিয়ে সেটি স্থলভাগে প্রবেশ করতে পারে।
সরাসরি বাংলায় আঘাত না হানলেও এই আবহাওয়া ব্যবস্থার প্রভাব পড়বে পশ্চিমবঙ্গে।
উত্তরবঙ্গেও আবহাওয়ার প্রভাব পড়ার সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। মঙ্গলবার দার্জিলিং, কালিম্পং, কোচবিহার, আলিপুরদুয়ার ও উত্তর দিনাজপুরে ভারী বৃষ্টির পূর্বাভাস দেওয়া হয়েছে। জলপাইগুড়িতে অতি ভারী বৃষ্টি হতে পারে। সিকিমেও বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে। সমুদ্র উত্তাল হওয়ায় শুক্রবার পর্যন্ত মৎস্যজীবীদের সমুদ্রে যেতে নিষেধ করা হয়েছে।
